narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__M4789470 reveals a regular demand pattern 
with CV=0.47 and right-skewed distribution. Lead time shows moderate behavior 
(mean=2.43 days, CV=0.45).

The optimized policy recommends safety stock of 12342 units and order quantity of 
139100 units, yielding a reorder point of 32312 units with a 25-day 
review period. This policy achieves 95% service level while reducing 
total annual costs by $14492.78 (89.7%) compared to the current SAP policy.

Capacity utilization is 44.3%, which is within acceptable limits.
The dominant source of lead time variability is transport (60%).

research_insights.selected_model: Classical EOQ with stochastic lead time
research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand regime is regular with CV=0.47. Classical inventory theory applies with safety stock calculated using lead-time demand variability.
